instruction: Find the potted plant, approach until the body touches it, and stop.
mediaNote: Chronological head-camera observations from this evaluation, displayed at two observations per second. This is not continuous action footage; playback time does not represent episode elapsed time. No interpolation or rerendering.
videoNote: Chronological head-camera observations from this evaluation, displayed at two observations per second. This is not continuous action footage; playback time does not represent episode elapsed time. No interpolation or rerendering.
timingNote: Trace timestamps use execution time; reported elapsed time also includes worker setup and cleanup. Observation playback has a separate clock.
callCoverage: Recorded native action events. Observation and helper calls are not enumerated; visible-state descriptions are supplied by the agent.

steps.title: Observe and decide
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# First cell: observe and yield to see the current scene
p.observe()
print("Observation taken. Awaiting image to locate the potted plant.")
steps.stdout: Observation taken. Awaiting image to locate the potted plant.
